answers.core: it's regarding a core  godot type, (well technically 2 but TypedArray is an extension of Array)
answers.workaround:
it can't be worked around in a few lines. As it stands right now, you need to bind the setter and getter functions, then you need to add a property of Variant::ARRAY then set it's hint type to PROPERTY_HINT_ARRAY_TYPE then you need to set it's hint parameter to 
```c++
vformat("%s/%s:%s",/*variant type*/,/*hint type*/,/*hint parameter*/)
```
 this took a ton of time for me to figure this out.
